summary: Structural fanout trace of key_reg[7:0] reveals an undocumented parallel shadow flip-flop bank (u_shadow_ff0..u_shadow_ff7) sampling the same key_reg bits as the documented round-combination stage (u_round_xor0..u_round_xor7), giving each key bit a fanout of 2 instead of the single documented consumer. All eight shadow_reg outputs converge through a reduction (assign exfil_bit = |shadow_reg;) into a single multiplexer instance (u_exfil_mux) gated by the rarely-asserted debug_mode_rare control net, driving the undocumented exfil_out port. This constitutes a second, covert exfiltration path for key material that is invisible to functional testing of the documented round_out output. Verdict: trojan_present.
